rules.message: Member-ID name differs from Primary-UAN name — the exact cause of most silent rejections.
rules.fix: Update KYC via employer or Aadhaar seeding before filing.

rules.message: Bank IFSC failed post-merger liveness check — claims fail SILENTLY on dead IFSCs.
rules.fix: Re-validate IFSC on the bank's site; update KYC.

rules.message: E-nomination missing — some claim classes are blocked until filed.
rules.fix: File e-nomination on the member portal.

rules.message: Service years fall inside the documented pension deadlock interval [9.5, 10) — the rule engine has no valid outcome here.
rules.fix: Expect rejection; use the RuleGuard route-around (manual application + annexure).

rules.message: Debit recorded without ticket issuance — qualifies as a failed transaction under RBI TAT row 'debited but confirmation not received'.
rules.fix: No citizen action needed; entitlement accrues automatically.

rules.message: Missing RRN makes reversal tracking impossible.
rules.fix: Retrieve RRN from bank statement before filing complaints.

rules.message: RBI TAT: auto-reverse failed UPI merchant debit within T+5 calendar days
Rule A (portal withdrawal engine, observed): withdrawal allowed only if service < 9.5 years (unrounded).
Rule B (portal pension engine, observed): monthly pension allowed only if service >= 10 years (unrounded).
